outcome_analysis: Kestral launched in Spring 2025 as an AI tool that turns customer feedback into prioritized work, and its site now sells Project Brain for agent coordination, which suggests repositioning. No funding beyond the YC deal, exit or shutdown was verified as of 2026-11. The market is crowded with feedback tools and the product is easy to copy, so durability depends on integrations and speed.
